as_told.title: Stargate remote viewers placed in submarines
as_told.place_text: Submarines at the bottom of the sea

plain: Hal Puthoff, a researcher who ran government experiments in remote viewing (trying to see faraway places with the mind alone), says his team put remote viewers in submarines and took them to the bottom of the ocean. According to Puthoff, they got some of their best results there, and the viewers remarked on how quiet it was, which he says rules out the idea that the ability works through electrical brain waves. The podcast host Jesse Michels later repeated the story, though without that last point.
